description: POLDER combines spectral, directional and polarization measurements to investigate clouds, aerosols and the biosphere. The ADEOS version used a wide-field camera with spectral filters and polarizers.
facility_description: ADEOS-I was a Japanese Earth-observation satellite carrying the first POLDER instrument developed by CNES and the University of Lille.
notes: CNES distinguishes POLDER-1/ADEOS-I, POLDER-2/ADEOS-II and POLDER-3/PARASOL. Do not apply PARASOL curve provenance to ADEOS without checking.
